One responding character A (vault minted by the REAL create); a General store; a project P whose officialMountPointId points at a database 'Project Official' store; and a set of P-linked database stores incl. TWO with the same name ('Shared Name' — ambiguous) and one DISABLED store. P4.6bg adds host-filesystem coverage: an fs-backed store 'FS Store' linked to P (mountType 'filesystem', sentinel basePath rewritten per-side); a legacy project L whose minted official store is DISABLED (forcing the <filesDir>/<projectId> legacy fallback); and a project F whose minted official store is flipped to mountType 'filesystem' (the project-official fs branch). The general scope + the fs branches materialize a temp tree on both sides and rewrite the canonical scratch prefix to a sentinel. All non-vault store ids pinned; the char vault + minted L/F official store ids are echoed to stderr.
